english.note: Use this for a physical ancient object or relic, especially an artifact; a specific monument may instead be called 古蹟.

examples.english: This piece of antiquity is said to have been left behind from ancient Rome.
examples.traditional: 呢件古物據講係古羅馬時代留下嚟㗎。
